mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diet_favorite_meal (user_id, meal_id, session_id, meal_json, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{mealId}, #{sessionId}, #{mealJson}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE session_id = VALUES(session_id), meal_json = VALUES(meal_json), updated_at = NOW()
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM diet_favorite_meal WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND meal_id = #{mealId}
